name: Mount Carmel

identification.note: Distinct from the town of Carmel in Judah's hill country, associated instead with Nabal and Abigail.

related_people.name: Elijah
related_people.role: called down fire from heaven and defeated the 450 prophets of Baal on this mountain

description: The mountain where Elijah confronted 450 prophets of Baal in a public contest to prove who the true God was, calling down fire from heaven when Baal's prophets' pleas went unanswered (1 Kings 18:16-40).
